description: This file defines the TaskRepository class that provides an API for managing Task data, including CRUD operations, toggling completion status, and seeding initial data, interfacing with the TaskDao.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing data access methods for Task entities, encapsulating data operations and interactions with the DAO.

methods.name: observeTasks
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of all tasks, allowing UI components to observe task data changes.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Retrieves a specific task by ID asynchronously.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Creates and inserts a new task with provided title, description, and optional due date; returns the generated task ID.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task, refreshing its 'updatedAt' timestamp.

methods.name: toggleCompleted
methods.description: Toggles the 'isCompleted' status of a task and updates its timestamp.

methods.name: seedIfEmpty
methods.description: Seeds initial example tasks if the task database is empty.
